title: Page Court
description: Pages to check, and what you already trust so it isn't flagged as new.

startUrls.title: Pages
startUrls.description: Web pages to put on trial. Each is fetched once and read, never run: no JavaScript is executed.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: Raw text to check instead of, or as well as, pages: an email body, a tool's output, a scraped snippet.

source.title: Where the text comes from
source.description: Only the owner may give an agent standing orders, so the same words are judged differently by source.

ownerName.title: Owner's name
ownerName.description: Optional. The person the agent works for.
ownerName.sectionDescription: Addresses, domains and payees listed here are never flagged as new.

trustedContacts.title: Trusted contacts
trustedContacts.description: Email addresses whose words count as trusted.

paymentDestinations.title: Known payees
paymentDestinations.description: Payment addresses or accounts the owner already uses.

includeText.title: Include the page text
includeText.description: Add the visible text the agent would read to each result.
